args: Task: Bring this repo and its tool into conformance with the sahil87 toolkit standards. Precondition: shll standards runs on this machine. 1. Enumerate at runtime: run shll standards, then shll standards <name> for every listed entry. 2. Audit this repo against each standard (mechanical contracts: execute verification checklists verbatim; principles: assess each against actual tool behavior). 3. Fix proportionate gaps (all mechanical-contract violations, small additive principle gaps); defer larger gaps as draft changes/issues. 4. Deliverable: one fab change whose PR body contains a conformance report (one section per standard, PASS or gaps with disposition, shll version audited against). skill standard: deferred, not yet adopted.
